about_the_game:
Codename Sunday is a top-down, fast paced, competitive shooter where you play as tanks in a multiplayer arena. Choose your most favorite overpowered killing machine to fulfil your needed duties, whether that is destroying other tanks to stay on top of the leaderboard, or working together to achieve a greater goal. Pick from a variety of game modes, vote on different maps, but most importantly, find the best way for you to have fun.

Codename Sunday is heavily inspired by the popular online HTML5 game "Diep", created by Brazilian developer Matheus Valadares in 2016, having multiple similarities, but at the same time iterating and introducing new interesting game mechanics, creating an unique spin on the game. If you were around to experience the golden age of web-games, then this title might be for you.
